supersedes_nothing: V71 contracts remain frozen historical inputs; V72 adds requirements learned after V71 was written.
purpose: Qualify one coupled hidden biological truth projected through FULL104-like, Stage4-like, SCENIC+-like, separate-nucleus, paired-multiome, perturbation and spatial observation operators before real multimodal training.
coupled_generation_rule: All synthetic datasets in one challenge version must derive from one hidden truth object and versioned regulatory graph. Independent per-dataset truth generation is forbidden.

S99_faithful_controls: control is fixed to the same promoter as the linked edge
control interval is non-overlapping with linked interval
distance matching uses the frozen Stage4 tolerance
edge is trimmed when no admissible control exists
world build fails closed when the matching audit fails
interval_geometry: one peak may overlap multiple Stage4 windows
crosswalks enumerate all overlaps rather than first-hit only

G2_S102.frozen_contract_gap: The historical contract says control-vs-control must not show excess but does not define test, statistic, alpha, or equivalence margin.
G2_S102.forbidden: V72 must not silently freeze the current two-sided 95% bootstrap-zero implementation as the scientific contract.
G2_S102.qualification_rule: Any future G2 pass criterion requires a new prospective contract justified independently of V2/K outcomes.

identity_requirements.planted_positive_control: At least one suffix must map to >1 donor so suffix inference provably fails.

scenicplus_reproducibility.BLAS_threads: explicit and recorded; default qualification target 1 thread inside each outer worker
scenicplus_reproducibility.worker_axis_gate: same scientific workload at different worker counts must yield digest-identical scientific outputs
scenicplus_reproducibility.union_score_reuse: motif-region scores may be computed once on RouteA union RouteB only after equivalence is demonstrated by name-based subsetting
shard_rules: PASS receipt only after files are closed and re-read
merge proves exact ordered union, no duplicates or omissions
scenicplus_reproducibility.execution_scripts: Long jobs execute immutable script snapshots; editing a mounted executing script is forbidden.

MORABITO_LIKE: separate RNA and ATAC nuclei sharing donors only

FULL.role: final dry run only after CI and stress promotion
